sections.heading: Dates & Chocolate Gift Box for Ramadan and Eid FAQ
sections.text: Questions Dates & Chocolate Gift Box for Ramadan and Eid FAQ When should I order for Ramadan? Plan backwards from your delivery date: sample 3–5 business days, bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval, then freight. Sea freight adds several weeks, so most Ramadan orders are confirmed two to three months ahead. Can the insert hold more than six dates? Yes. The style shown has six cavities; the insert is cut from the size of your dates or chocolates, so the count follows your range and the box is sized around it. Can the lid carry Arabic text? Yes. Arabic and English text, your logo and a greeting can be foil stamped on the lid or printed inside it. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you supply the dates? No. We make and ship the empty boxes and inserts; dates and chocolates are packed at your site.
